== Course of events ==

The discovery comes on the heels of Glinda the Good's revelation that Ozma, daughter of the former King Pastoria, is the rightful heir to the throne of the Emerald City, hidden away by the Wizard of Oz with the aid of Old Mombi. From that audience, the Gump had carried the Scarecrow and his companions across the South Country to Glinda's domain, landing at last in the gardens of her palace, where the Sorceress's soldiers brought them before her.

It is at this point that the Scarecrow discovers he has lost the pepper-box containing the two remaining Wishing Pills, apparently left behind in the nest.

The loss precedes the Scarecrow's explanation to Glinda that General Jinjur's Army of Revolt has seized the Emerald City and stolen its emerald jewels, as he asks the Sorceress for her help.
